content.name: Marcus Bellamy
content.title: Senior Customer Service Representative and Escalations Lead
content.summary: Customer service professional with 13 years across insurance, medical supply, broadband and banking contact centers. Handles the toughest escalations for a credit union serving 140,000 members, coaches a pod of eight representatives and lifted first-contact resolution from 71% to 84%.

experience.title: Customer Service Representative
bullets: Answered 70 to 90 inbound calls a day on policy changes, billing and hurricane-season claims intake.
Kept average handle time under the 6-minute target while holding a 94% quality score on monitored calls.
Volunteered for the catastrophe response team after two major storms, working extended shifts to log more than 1,200 first notices of loss.

experience.title: Senior Customer Service Representative
bullets: Resolved order, insurance authorization and delivery problems for home oxygen and mobility patients, many of them elderly callers.
Wrote plain-language call scripts for Medicare documentation requests, cutting repeat calls on that topic by about 30%.
Became the go-to contact for HIPAA identity verification questions and refreshed the team's job aid twice a year.

experience.title: Team Lead, Customer Care
bullets: Led a remote team of 14 agents handling billing and technical tier-1 contacts across phone, chat and email.
Introduced weekly calibration sessions and side-by-side coaching, raising the team's CSAT from 3.9 to 4.4 out of 5.
Built a Zendesk macro library of 60 approved responses that shortened chat handle time by nearly two minutes.
Reduced voluntary agent turnover on my team to 12% a year, compared with 31% across the wider floor.

experience.title: Senior Customer Service Representative and Escalations Lead
bullets: Own complex member escalations, including disputed card transactions, fraud holds and loan payment issues, for a 140,000-member credit union.
Coach a pod of eight representatives and lead their monthly quality reviews against Regulation E and complaint-handling standards.
Mapped the top 20 reasons calls were transferred and rewrote knowledge articles, lifting first-contact resolution from 71% to 84%.
Partner with the fraud team on a callback process that recovered about $210,000 for members in its first year.

achievements.title: President's Circle 2024
achievements.detail: One of five employees credit-union-wide recognized for member service results.

achievements.title: Mentor program founder
achievements.detail: Started a peer mentor program at Suncoast Broadband that paired 40 new hires with experienced agents.
